gloss: grass clippings; cut grass; mowed grass

definitions.gloss: grass clippings; cut grass; mowed grass
definitions.explanation: Grass that has been cut or mown, such as clippings left over from mowing a lawn or field. From {刈|か}る (to cut, to mow) + {草|くさ} (grass).

examples.japanese: {刈|か}り{草|くさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
{刈|か}り{草|くさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Use the cut grass as fertilizer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刈|か}り{草|くさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コンポスト→コンポスト：29822_konposuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the grass clippings from the garden into the compost.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ (to mow, to cut) + ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass). Refers to the cut grass itself, not the act of mowing.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{草刈|くさか}り→草刈り：22813_kusakari⟧: mowing or cutting grass (the activity)
- ⟦{刈|か}り{取|と}る→刈り取る：21025_karitoru⟧: to mow, to reap
- {枯|か}れ{草|くさ}: withered, dried grass
